tool.name: nf-core expansionhunter
tool.description: Estimate repeat sizes using NGS data
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ ExpansionHunter \\ ${args} \\ --reads ${bam} \\ --output-prefix ${prefix} \\ --reference ${fasta} \\ --variant-catalog ${variant_catalog}
bgzip --threads ${task.cpus} ${args2} ${prefix}.vcf bgzip --threads ${task.cpus} ${args2} ${prefix}.json
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": expansionhunter: \$( echo \$(ExpansionHunter --version 2>&1) | head -1 | sed 's/^.*ExpansionHunter v//') bgzip: \$(echo \$(bgzip -h 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*Version: //;s/Usage:.*//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Estimate repeat sizes using NGS data
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: expansionhunter Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/expansionhunter ]]>
